variants.production: unmodified src/lib, Keep (control; must equal none)
variants.cut128: unmodified src/lib, Cut at 128 (reference column, no weighting)

metrics.compositing: encoded-sRGB straight-alpha blend: c*a + bg*(1-a), a = byte/255; output uses its own alpha
metrics.errors: srgb8Rmse (encoded 0-255 per channel), linearRmse (linear light x255 per channel), oklabRmse (Euclidean dE_ok); weighted by frame duration for animations
metrics.regions: by SOURCE alpha: opaque 255, strong 128-254, soft 16-127, faint 1-15, all >=1
metrics.salient: exact RGB mass alpha/255 x count x duration -> 15-bit RGB bins (mean Oklab) -> leader clustering radius 0.04 dE_ok in descending mass; salient if >= 1% of visible mass; lost if nearest visible output color > 0.08 dE_ok

meta.decode: Sharp/libvips 8-bit sRGB RGBA (not browser decode); per-frame raw hashes recorded
